On pausing: your plan is Basic, billed monthly, so it is eligible. Our help centre says you can pause a monthly plan for up to three months from the same page. A paused plan is not charged and keeps your data. Annual plans cannot be paused. To pause, go to your account's subscription page and use the pause option there.

If you would rather stop the plan altogether, you can cancel it from Account, Subscription, Cancel plan. Your dashboards stay available until the paid period ends, and your reports are kept for 90 days after that, and you can export them to CSV at any time.
